fusion_reference: Hungarian ground-plane association <=100 cm + equal averaging for matched cross-camera observations
zone_definition: Generic PCA-based Zone A/B/C fitted on Development + Validation GT only
entry_exit: Internal zone transitions only; track birth/death excluded
dwell: Complete internal visits only; censored visits excluded
flow: One directed source-zone -> destination-zone transition counted once using ENTRY event stream
important_interpretation_rules: Raw occupancy-error correlation must not be interpreted without crowd-size control.
Ground MAE must be interpreted with Recall/F1.
Dwell MAE is conditional on matched complete visits.
Total flow count alone is insufficient; direction composition must also be evaluated.
Generic WILDTRACK zones must not be assigned airport semantics.
